grid.classification: PROPOSED values, not tuned or measured

dry_run_subset.purpose: Pipeline exercise only. These values cannot select or freeze a model.

no_silence.proposed_range: At least one output-port spike in no-threat trials across the calibration seed panel.
no_silence.justification: Walking cannot emerge from a network that never activates an output port.

no_saturation.proposed_range: Whole-population mean rate below 100 Hz in every control.
no_saturation.justification: Persistent near-ceiling activity would erase event timing and graph differences.

spontaneous_movement.proposed_range: Movement command present in 0.05 to 0.80 of no-threat control intervals.
spontaneous_movement.justification: The model needs spontaneous walking without continuous maximum motion.

looming_escape_probability.justification: A nondegenerate response leaves room for wiring and strike-speed comparisons.

looming_exceeds_non_looming.proposed_range: Looming escape probability exceeds matched non-looming by at least 0.10.
looming_exceeds_non_looming.justification: Expansion should add information beyond matched final angular size.

selection_rule: Before outcomes are inspected, retain settings passing every criterion, then choose the lowest no-threat whole-population mean rate; break ties lexicographically by synaptic scale, noise probability, noise increment, and input gain.
controls: matched non-looming with the same final size
C-SIMPLE single threshold on angular size fitted with the same calibration budget
C-TIMER fixed 30 ms latency from V2A

nulls.calibration_rule: Every null uses the same grid, seed budget, controls, criteria, and selection rule as the real graph.

metrics: first escape command offset before impact
H1.comparison: Real graph percentile within at least 20 degree- and sign-preserving null graphs per family using a permutation test.

H2.comparison: Real graph percentile within null distributions and the same noise fed straight to the decoder, using permutation tests.
